extending.stem: Set P is 52, 54, 56, 58, 60. Set Q is 52, 54, 56, 58, 160. Which choice pairs each set with the right measures?
choices: P: mean and MAD; Q: median and IQR
P: median and IQR; Q: mean and MAD
extending.explanation: Set P is evenly spread with no outlier, so report the mean (56) and the MAD. Set Q has an outlier, 160, far above the tight group of four. It drags the mean up to 76, so report the median (56) and the IQR for Q.
choiceFeedback: Set Q has an outlier (160). It pulls the mean up to 76, so mean and MAD do not describe Q well.
This is backwards. P is evenly spread with no outlier, and Q is the set with the outlier.
Median and IQR are for sets with an outlier. P has no outlier, so P uses mean and MAD.
hints: Look at the shape of each set first. Is any value far away from the rest?
Set P goes up evenly by 2. Set Q has one value that jumps far above the others.
Evenly spread data with no outlier uses one pair of measures. Data with an outlier uses the other pair.
extending.stemEs: El conjunto P es 52, 54, 56, 58, 60. El conjunto Q es 52, 54, 56, 58, 160. ¿Qué opción asigna a cada conjunto las medidas correctas?
extending.explanationEs: El conjunto P está repartido parejo y no tiene valor atípico, así que se reporta la media (56) y la MAD. El conjunto Q tiene un valor atípico, 160, muy por encima del grupo de cuatro. Sube la media a 76, así que para Q se reporta la mediana (56) y el IQR.
hintsEs: Primero mira la forma de cada conjunto. ¿Hay algún valor muy lejos de los demás?
El conjunto P sube de 2 en 2. El conjunto Q tiene un valor que salta muy por encima de los otros.
Los datos repartidos parejo y sin valor atípico usan una pareja de medidas. Los datos con un valor atípico usan la otra pareja.

extending.stem: A dog weighs 143 pounds. The dose is 4 mg for every 1 kg. (1 kg ≈ 2.2 lbs) How much medicine does the dog need?
extending.explanation: Step one: convert to kilograms. 143 ÷ 2.2 = 65 kg. Step two: apply the rate. 65 × 4 = 260. The dog needs a 260 mg dose.
choiceFeedback: You multiplied the pounds by the dose. The rate is per kilogram, so convert to kilograms first.
65 kg is only step one. Now multiply by the rate, 4 mg for each kilogram.
You multiplied by 2.2. To change pounds to kilograms, divide by 2.2.
hints: What unit does the dose rate use: pounds or kilograms?
Change the weight to that unit first. Going from pounds to kilograms means dividing by 2.2.
Once you have the kilograms, multiply by the dose for each kilogram.
extending.stemEs: Un perro pesa 143 libras. La dosis es de 4 mg por cada 1 kg. (1 kg ≈ 2.2 lb) ¿Cuánta medicina necesita el perro?
extending.explanationEs: Paso uno: convierte a kilogramos. 143 ÷ 2.2 = 65 kg. Paso dos: aplica la tasa. 65 × 4 = 260. El perro necesita una dosis de 260 mg.
hintsEs: ¿Qué unidad usa la tasa de la dosis: libras o kilogramos?
Primero cambia el peso a esa unidad. Para pasar de libras a kilogramos se divide entre 2.2.
Cuando tengas los kilogramos, multiplica por la dosis de cada kilogramo.

extending.stem: A class has 25 students and 8 of them walk to school. What percent of the class walks?
extending.explanation: Multiply both terms of 8 out of 25 by 4 to compare to 100: 8 × 4 = 32 and 25 × 4 = 100. So 32 out of 100 is 32%.
choiceFeedback: 8 is the number of students who walk. Rewrite the ratio out of 100 first.
25 is the whole class, not the percent.
68% is the students who do NOT walk (100 − 32).
hints: Write the ratio: 8 out of 25.
What do you multiply 25 by to get 100?
Multiply BOTH terms by that same number.
extending.stemEs: Una clase tiene 25 estudiantes y 8 de ellos van caminando a la escuela. ¿Qué porcentaje de la clase va caminando?
extending.explanationEs: Multiplica los dos términos de 8 de 25 por 4 para compararlos con 100: 8 × 4 = 32 y 25 × 4 = 100. Entonces 32 de cada 100 es 32%.
hintsEs: Escribe la razón: 8 de 25.
¿Por cuánto multiplicas 25 para llegar a 100?
Multiplica LOS DOS términos por el mismo número.

extending.stem: On a 10 × 10 grid, 3 full columns and 6 more squares are shaded. What percent of the grid is shaded?
extending.explanation: Each column has 10 squares, so 3 columns is 30 squares. Add 6 more squares: 36 squares out of 100 is 36%.
choiceFeedback: That adds 3 + 6 without counting that each column holds 10 squares.
63% swaps the digits. Three columns is 30 squares, not 60.
The whole grid is only 100 squares, so it cannot be more than 100%.
hints: How many squares are in one column?
Count the squares in 3 columns, then add the 6 extra.
Each square is 1%.
extending.stemEs: En una cuadrícula de 10 × 10 hay 3 columnas completas y 6 cuadros más sombreados. ¿Qué porcentaje de la cuadrícula está sombreado?
extending.explanationEs: Cada columna tiene 10 cuadros, así que 3 columnas son 30 cuadros. Suma 6 cuadros más: 36 cuadros de 100 es 36%.
hintsEs: ¿Cuántos cuadros hay en una columna?
Cuenta los cuadros de 3 columnas y luego suma los 6 extra.
Cada cuadro es 1%.

extending.instructions: Write each ratio as an equivalent ratio out of 100, then as a percent.

hints: For 9 out of 25: 25 × 4 = 100, so multiply 9 by 4.
For 13 out of 20: 20 × 5 = 100, so multiply 13 by 5.
The percent is the first number of the out-of-100 ratio.
hintsEs: Para 9 de 25: 25 × 4 = 100, así que multiplica 9 por 4.
Para 13 de 20: 20 × 5 = 100, así que multiplica 13 por 5.
El porcentaje es el primer número de la razón sobre 100.

extending.stem: A percent bar is split into 4 equal parts and 3 of the parts are shaded. What percent of the bar is shaded?
extending.explanation: 3 out of 4 becomes 75 out of 100 when you multiply both terms by 25. On the percent bar, each of the 4 equal parts is 25% (100% ÷ 4 = 25%), so 3 shaded parts equal 75% (3 × 25% = 75%).
extending.explanationEs: 3 de 4 se convierte en 75 de 100 al multiplicar los dos términos por 25. En la barra de porcentaje, cada una de las 4 partes iguales es 25% (100% ÷ 4 = 25%), por lo que 3 partes sombreadas equivalen a 75% (3 × 25% = 75%).
choiceFeedback: 3 is the number of shaded parts, not the percent.
25% is only ONE of the four parts.
34 just joins the digits 3 and 4. Scale the ratio to 100 instead.
hints: Write the ratio: 3 out of 4.
What do you multiply 4 by to get 100?
Multiply BOTH terms by that same number.
extending.stemEs: Una barra de porcentaje está dividida en 4 partes iguales y 3 de las partes están sombreadas. ¿Qué porcentaje de la barra está sombreado?
hintsEs: Escribe la razón: 3 de 4.
¿Por cuánto multiplicas 4 para llegar a 100?

extending.stem: A rhombus has a side length of 12.5 cm and a perpendicular height of 8 cm. Find the area.
extending.explanation: A rhombus is a parallelogram, so A = b × h. The base is 12.5 cm and the perpendicular height is 8 cm. 12.5 × 8 = 100, so the area is 100 cm².
choiceFeedback: You multiplied the side by itself (12.5 × 12.5). Use the perpendicular height, 8 cm.
You divided by 2. A rhombus is a parallelogram, so its area is b × h with no halving.
You added 12.5 + 8. Area is found by multiplying.
hints: A rhombus is a parallelogram. Which area formula goes with it?
Any side can be the base. Use the perpendicular height, not a slanted side.
Multiply the base by the height and label the answer in square units.
extending.stemEs: Un rombo tiene un lado de 12.5 cm y una altura perpendicular de 8 cm. Halla el área.
extending.explanationEs: Un rombo es un paralelogramo, así que A = b × h. La base es 12.5 cm y la altura perpendicular es 8 cm. 12.5 × 8 = 100, entonces el área es 100 cm².
hintsEs: Un rombo es un paralelogramo. ¿Qué fórmula de área le corresponde?
Cualquier lado puede ser la base. Usa la altura perpendicular, no un lado inclinado.
Multiplica la base por la altura y escribe la respuesta en unidades cuadradas.

extending.explanation: Area of one tile: A = b × h = 9 × 7 = 63 cm². Four tiles: 63 × 4 = 252 cm².
choiceFeedback: 63 cm² is the area of just one tile. Multiply by the 4 tiles.
You used 9 × 9 for each tile. Use the perpendicular height, 7 cm, not the second side.
You added 9 + 7 for each tile. Area comes from multiplying base times height.
hints: Find the area of one tile first.
Use A = b × h with the side as the base and the perpendicular height.
Then think about how many tiles there are.

extending.stem: A trapezoid has parallel bases of 11 in. and 17 in. and a height of 7 in. Find the area.
extending.explanation: A = ½ × (b1 + b2) × h. Add the bases first: 11 + 17 = 28. Multiply by the height: 28 × 7 = 196. Half of 196 is 98 in².
choiceFeedback: 196 is the answer before halving. The last step is to take half.
119 is 17 × 7. You used only one base. Add both bases first.
You added 11 + 17 + 7. Add only the bases, multiply by the height, then halve.
hints: Which numbers are the bases and which one is the height?
Add the two bases first. That is the part inside the parentheses.
Multiply that sum by the height, then take half.

extending.stem: A student says 4 to the 4th power is 16 because 4 × 4 = 16. What is the correct value?
extending.explanation: The exponent 4 means four copies of the base: 4 × 4 × 4 × 4. 4 × 4 = 16, then 16 × 4 = 64, then 64 × 4 = 256. The value is 256.
choiceFeedback: 16 is only two copies of 4. The exponent 4 means four copies.
64 is three copies of 4. You need one more factor of 4.
8 is 4 + 4. An exponent means repeated multiplication, not addition.
hints: How many copies of the base does the exponent 4 tell you to multiply?

Multiply in order: 4 × 4 first, then multiply that answer by 4, then by 4 again.

hintsEs: ¿Cuántas copias de la base indica el exponente 4 que se multipliquen?
